context: A mom helps her young son sort silly versus important worries
purpose: Teach: 当てはまる/数少ない/ほほ/判り/爽やか/気持ちよく/くだらない/けっして

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔ちゃん、今日はね、心配ごとを二つに分けてみようか。爽やかな気持ちで眠れるようにね。
lines.en: Sho-chan, today let's sort your worries into two piles, so you can sleep with a fresh feeling.
lines.style: Warm maternal voice, gentle and reassuring tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うーん、でもどれが大事でどれがくだらない心配か、僕には判りにくいよ。
lines.en: Hmm, but it's hard for me to tell which worries are important and which are silly.
lines.style: Young child voice, slightly whiny and uncertain

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうだね。じゃあママが質問するから、当てはまる方のお山に置いてみて。
lines.en: Right. So mom will ask questions, and you place each worry on the pile it matches.
lines.style: Patient teaching voice, soft and encouraging cadence

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: わかった!えーっと、お友達が僕のこと変なあだ名で呼ぶの、これは大事?
lines.en: Okay! Um, my friend calling me a weird nickname — is that an important one?
lines.style: Curious child voice, slightly anxious but engaged

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ほほを膨らませてるね。けっして無視はしないけど、それはたぶんくだらない冗談の方かな。
lines.en: Your cheeks are all puffed up. We won't ever ignore it, but that's probably the silly joke pile.
lines.style: Tender amused voice, lightly teasing with affection

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: じゃあさ、宇宙が消えちゃうかもって心配は?昨日テレビで銀河の話してたんだ。
lines.en: Then what about worrying the universe might disappear? They talked about galaxies on TV yesterday.
lines.style: Wide-eyed child voice, dramatic and serious about cosmos

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、それも数少ない壮大な心配だけど、今夜は気持ちよく眠ることのほうが大事よ。
lines.en: Haha, that's one of those rare grand worries, but tonight sleeping peacefully matters more.
lines.style: Soft laughing voice, warm motherly chuckle and wisdom

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、ママ。明日になったら、また判り直すね。おやすみなさい。
lines.en: Okay, mom. Tomorrow I'll sort them out again. Good night.
lines.style: Sleepy child voice, content and trusting tone
